lateGraceMinutes.title: Late arrival grace
lateGraceMinutes.description: Clocking in later than this after the start time counts as late.
lateGraceMinutes.example: 15 min: with an 08:30 start, 08:45 is on time and 08:46 is late.

lateDeductionMode.title: Late arrivals: report or deduct
lateDeductionMode.description: Report only flags late arrivals without changing pay. Enforced turns late arrivals into deducted days.
lateDeductionMode.example: Enforced, 2 per half day: 2 late arrivals = 0.5 day deducted.

latesPerHalfDay.title: Late arrivals per half day
latesPerHalfDay.description: When late deduction is enforced, every this-many late arrivals in a month cost half a day.
latesPerHalfDay.example: 2: 5 late arrivals in a month = 1 day deducted (two pairs); the fifth waits for a pair.

earlyDepartureGraceMinutes.title: Early departure grace
earlyDepartureGraceMinutes.description: Leaving up to this many minutes before the scheduled end is not early.
earlyDepartureGraceMinutes.example: 15 min (default): with a 17:30 end, leaving at 17:15 is fine; 17:14 is flagged.

earlyDepartureDeductMinutes.title: Early departure: half-day threshold
earlyDepartureDeductMinutes.description: Leaving more than this before the scheduled end can cost half a day.
earlyDepartureDeductMinutes.example: 60 min: with a 17:30 end, leaving before 16:30 counts as over an hour early.

earlyDepartureMode.title: Early departure: report or deduct
earlyDepartureMode.description: Report only shows the would-deduct amount. Enforced deducts half a day.
earlyDepartureMode.example: Enforced: leaving at 16:00 without approval = 0.5 day deducted.

enrolmentGraceWorkingDays.title: New-starter scanner grace
enrolmentGraceWorkingDays.description: New employees who aren't on the scanner yet are not marked absent. No limit = until the day after their first scan.
enrolmentGraceWorkingDays.example: 5 (default): at most their first 5 working days are excused; later no-scan days are flagged.

forgotToClockFlagThreshold.title: Forgot-to-scan review flag
forgotToClockFlagThreshold.description: Approved forgot-to-scan explanations in a month that flag the employee for HR review.
forgotToClockFlagThreshold.example: 3: the third approved forgot-to-scan in a month raises a flag.

unpaidLeaveCountsRestDays.title: Unpaid leave includes days off
unpaidLeaveCountsRestDays.description: When on, unpaid leave deducts every calendar day in its range, including days off and holidays.
unpaidLeaveCountsRestDays.example: On: unpaid leave Friday–Monday = 4 days deducted. Off (default): duty days only; days off and holidays stay paid.

monthDays.title: Days in a payroll month
monthDays.description: Every month is paid on a 30-day basis. Fixed: the joiner and leaver rules depend on it.
monthDays.example: Joined on the 17th: 14 paid days, in any month.

leaverAllowanceMode.title: Allowances for leavers
leaverAllowanceMode.description: How transport and monthly bonus are paid to someone who leaves during the month.
leaverAllowanceMode.example: Prorated: left on the 20th = 20/30 of transport and bonus. Full amount: the whole month.

allowancesReducedByAbsence.title: Absences reduce allowances
allowancesReducedByAbsence.description: When on, absent days also reduce transport and monthly bonus.
allowancesReducedByAbsence.example: On: 2 absent days in a 30-day month = allowances × 28/30.

pensionEmployeePct.title: Employee pension %
pensionEmployeePct.description: Deducted from the employee: percent of earned salary.

pensionEmployerPct.title: Employer pension %
pensionEmployerPct.description: Paid by the company: percent of earned salary.

pensionBase.title: Pension is calculated on
pensionBase.description: Fixed to earned salary (basic ÷ 30 × paid days).

incomeTaxBrackets.title: Income tax bands
incomeTaxBrackets.description: Tax = taxable income × the band's rate − the band's deduction, using the band the income falls in.

transportTaxable.title: Transport allowance is taxable
transportTaxable.description: When on, the transport allowance is added to taxable income.
transportTaxable.example: Off: a 2,550 transport allowance is never taxed.

hoursDivisor.title: Overtime hourly divisor
hoursDivisor.description: Overtime hourly rate = basic salary ÷ this number.

holidayHoursDivisor.title: Holiday overtime hourly divisor
holidayHoursDivisor.description: Public-holiday overtime hourly rate = basic salary ÷ this number.

multipliers.title: Overtime multipliers
multipliers.description: Overtime pay = hourly rate × hours × the multiplier for the time of day or day type.

allowedInitiators.title: Who can file requests
allowedInitiators.description: For each request type: the employee themselves, their direct supervisor (direct reports only), or a delegate (HR, department or discipline lead). Takes effect as soon as it is saved. Only a System Administrator can change it.
allowedInitiators.example: Site assignment = supervisor + delegate: employees cannot file their own site assignment.

siteDayScheduledHoursClaimable.title: Office hours claimable as overtime on site days
siteDayScheduledHoursClaimable.description: Default off: site and office days use the same rule — only time outside the work schedule is overtime. When on, scheduled office hours on an approved site-assignment day can also be claimed. Only a System Administrator can change it.
siteDayScheduledHoursClaimable.example: Off (default): site day 09:00-12:00 is not claimable. On: that window = 3h normal overtime.

lunchCountsAsOvertime.title: Lunch break counts as overtime
lunchCountsAsOvertime.description: When on, the lunch break on a working day can be entered as overtime.
lunchCountsAsOvertime.example: Off: 12:30–13:30 can't be claimed as overtime.

unusedLeavePayout.title: Unused leave payout
unusedLeavePayout.description: Pay unused annual leave in the final month. Saved now; payroll does not use it yet.

severancePay.title: Severance pay
severancePay.description: Severance on separation, with parameters entered by HR. Saved now; payroll does not use it yet.

noticePay.title: Notice pay
